settings.warmup: one unmeasured run of each configuration before the measured repetitions
settings.cache: operating-system file cache warm: inputs are written and then read by the warm-up run
settings.isolation: each run in a fresh process
settings.peak_memory_method: resident set size summed over the worker's process tree, sampled every 20 ms; short peaks between samples can be missed
